items.description: Athenaeum is a mashup of Goodreads.com and Toronto Public Library created by Chris Nolan. Goodreads API allows to personalize book preferences, reason why the mashup can be found useful by members of the Toronto Public Library. Contents include how to use, tests, and known issues. Just like the author, users can automatically take checked out items and add them to Goodreads.com shelves.
Easy-to-use web app that lets a user share and discuss highlighted passages from books they are reading on their Amazon Kindle or Kindle app utilizing the Goodreads and Twitter APIs.
What's better, the book or the movie? The answer to an age old debate, using science.
bookfriend is an Android application which creates companion guides for any book instantly and seamlessly wherever you are.
GdRd is a Twitter bot that fetches a book's rating on Goodreads.com. Just mention/@reply @GdRd with the ISBN number of a book and GdRd will reply with the book's rating.

An instant messenger bot to search for full forms of abbreviations. If you type ROFL in your GTalk/Jabber window you get all the possible full forms of the abbreviation. The service uses Abbreviations.com API and is meant for non commercial use only.
Service for locationbudget hotels and motels in North America. 30,000 properties listed. Budget Bellhop searches discount hotel sites to locate hotel discounts and cheap rates.

Life2Life is a real store in a virtual world. Uses the Amazon and SecondLife APIs to allow you to shop in virtual space. This link brings you to the story about it, you need Second Life to see it in action.
BedMap is an interactive hotel map with detailed pricing comparisons and help options. Search more than 90,000 available hotels and book a room instantly.
Loku is an application that displays local neighborhood maps and lets users explore what is happening nearby. It displays news stories and videos, events and deals.

jiffr is a picture based dating service that works without words. You introduce yourself without words, only using the language of your flickr pictures and so you get a date without words. This is a free service.

Find user-generated cell phone signals by major service providers. Find dead spots, and compare signal strengths. Add your own signal, it only takes 15 seconds, helps the map grow more valuable for cell phone users.
Tracking campaign appearances by major candidates. In French.

Bitcoin Digital Downloads is a complete solution that allows you to automate the delivery of digital products after your customers pay you using Bitcoin. Bitcoin Digital Downloads can also be used as a Bitcoin payment terminal allowing you to receive Bitcoin payments for things like freelance or contract work, donations and more. Download links are encrypted to prevent unauthorized downloads and can also have an expiry time.
Send SMS notifications to subscribers when you publish a new post on your Wordpress-powered website. Currently in Beta testing.
Map of all property values across Franklin county.
For those who like to be inspired by random delicious bookmarks.
TextListen is a mobile music service. Just text the artist and name of a song you want to hear. The service will call you back and play the song for you on the speaker.
Looks at jobs and careers around the world with a Google Map and some nice tools.
Give away the junk that is cluttering up your life or find stuff you really need for free.

Jay Crim and Shekar Davarya spent the summer of 2002 driving across the country on Route 66, collecting interviews with the people who live, work and travel on the old road. This multimedia map is the result. Built with the new My Maps service.
Earn/Learn Web helps users find the best websites to earnl/learn. Sites range from best PayPerTask to best SellYourArt.
Collaborative mapping for virtual tourists.

WebServicesPros provide automation between Americommerce shopping cart and Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) systems through the use of AC API Web Services and different ERP and Accounting Softwares. The WebServicesPros Desktop application serves as an intermediary application to bridge the two systems as well as provide additional features to both ends when they are not present. The configurable and customized solutions allow several different shopping carts or even different cart providers to integrate while assisting the back office by making the process efficient and seamless from the accounting and fulfillment point of view.

Everyone knows texting and driving is dangerous, yet when a text message comes in, it's difficult not to respond. AT&T DriveMode is a free* app that silences incoming text message alerts so you can stay focused while driving. The AT&T DriveMode iOS App for iPhone uses the In-App Messaging API to send auto replies on behalf of the driver indicating the driver is on the road and unavailable to text. The AT&T Webhooks Notifications API provides push notifications for the AT&T DriveMode iOS App. *Data and messaging rates apply
Useful mashup that lets you see who has been donating money to which political party by zip code. Good combination of raw data, charts and maps. Data source is The Fundrace Project.
Search millions of local and international movie titles and video trailers from YouTube. Also has links to Google for more information about your search term.

Fitabase is a research platform that collects data from internet connected consumer devices. Fitabase is for anyone wanting to aggregate, analyze, and export data gathered from many device wearers. With this service, organizations will be able to safely gather and analyze their data for their business. Fitabase provides the customers with visual live data along with the ability to easily download and read their content in a standard spreadsheet format.
Another Tweet On The Wall is a free Twitter Wall allowing you to display tweets filtered on your keywords in a funny way.

Infinilla shows 3 random picks from Dribbble using its API. You can click the refresh link on the bottom of the page and get 3 randomly chosen images that you can use for inspiration. If you want to get more info about the image you see, just click on it and you will get to the page of that image on Dribbble.

A website that uses the bol.com API to display products, especially focused on special deals. Besides regular browsing and searching, visitors can subscribe to be updated about price changes of specific products by e-mail and twitter. Products are being enriched by using several API's such as tmdb, moviemeter.nl (dutch movie API), youtube and Twitter.

MemoryAide.com helps people remember anything from birthdays and doctor appointments, to picking up milk on the way home from work. Simply schedule an email, text message or phone call reminder for yourself, friend or family member.
Popup Chinese allows people to get feedback on their chinese pronunciation by recording a message that will then be listened to by teachers in China during their business hours.
Using the Google Translate API, this web app shows translations of any English word into over 30 European languages, on a map.
A Google Maps interface to a database of thousands of hang gliding and paragliding sites around the world, with a feed to show the same in Google Earth.
Google Map of earthquakes worldwide within the past seven days.
You-Twit is a mashup that aggregates Youtube videos that are trending on twitter.

Our powerful, easy-to-use background check search tools and technology enable fast access to comprehensive background check data with a range of search solutions that meet your varying needs. The ProntoScreen instant background check searched our proprietary criminal records database as well as other public sources like court records, incarceration records, prison records, probation & parole release information & more!
Track the most popular news and other threads online via RSSmeme. Integrates with FriendFeed API.

Hinge is a dating app available on iOS and Android. Using Hinge, people are able to meet others through connections with their friends. Hinge is also an Uber API partner, allowing users to quickly coordinate date pickup from the chat tab from within the Hinge app.
Plant and gardening maps featuring an interactive USDA zone hardiness map.
A mashup of Napa Valley wineries using Google Maps and Flickr.

Displays a list of ringtone and mp3 content available from Dada. Obani.com is passing the artist name to the search API. Dada is returning album art and a list of songs and track previews to Obani.com.
FiWiStore provides a pleasant online shopping experience for internet user. Search, buy and review products through our easy to use online store.
SharedBook used its API and Google widgets to build Blog2Print, a new blog printing widget that can be used by writers and their readers to turn blog posts into books.
Finda Park was started as a fun app just to allow people to find parks in the Seattle area using their zip code. This app uses open data from data.seattle.gov.

Qabic allows you to effortlessly handle Q&A for your talks/panels by allowing your audience to submit and vote on questions throughout the event. This allows the best questions to be easily accesible both during and after your talk/panel.
Find babysitters, nannies, and other care options visually with Google Maps.
A partnership between FEED, The GAP and DonorsChoose.org. This site uses the DonorsChoose to find local classrooms who need support.
Custom niche web search engine.

This widget will display the latest items from the Digg website. You can change its preferences to point to change the minimum number of diggs and count of displayed items. More than just RSS, it displays both the item content and images.
Barnard Marcus UK property and branch locator. Search for real estate to buy or rent.
Always updated geo-targeted web programming jobs. Neatly organized data from Indeed.com.
Share your cycling, walking, hiking, and paddling routes with the world. See maps, photos, and stats about each route, or create your own.
Mashup of Google Maps with the most recent venture capital deals and startups in Silicon Valley.

Bridge is an agency that provides full service for NationBuilder customers. Services include handling strategy, marketing, branding, and execution of brands. Bridge's services cover website management, communications, and finances.

Dino Map provides users with a visual and interactive way to explore all of the fossil records in the Paleobiology Database, which includes plants, insects, mammals, reptiles, dinosaurs, and more. This mashup was built using the Google Maps API.
The Longest Poem in the World is composed by aggregating real-time public Twitter updates and selecting those that rhyme. Created as a social experiment, the poem is growing at ~4000 verses/day.
Branded Red Letter Days affiliate site for SEO and PPC. Uses Red Letter Days feed and Google Maps API to map gift experiences by UK locations.
Find celebrity videos, especially for Latin stars. Uses the YouTube API. Note that some videos are adult content and not safe for work, NSFW.
Find pick-up spots using this collaborative map.
Pin point the locations of aviation art prints.
